summary: Dossiers are largely sound on long-established history (Hinkle, Attucks, Milan, Reggie's 8.9, the ABA titles, FloJo, Indiana Avenue) and consistent with the verified current facts (Haliburton's return, Zubac, the Oct 30 Cup opener, Hinkle Dec 11). Ten fixes were made in place: New Castle capacity (about 7,300, not 9,300), girls' state-final timing, Mel Daniels' MVPs, the ABA color description, a Pacers Finals-team error, the Boom Baby attribution to Mark Boyle, a false Specter reference, Larson's Double, an unsourced poll claim and Hali 1 naming. Three live checks: Puma is confirmed (signed Oct 2024), the City Edition archive is racing 2019-20, Indy script 2023-25 and Mixtape 2025-26 (no Hickory edition found), and Milktooth briefly closed in 2026. Brief fixes for the editor: use verified City Edition history, say Oct 30 is the only confirmed home date and stop saying 'Hali 1', reconcile the royal-blue hex, and treat small venues and shops as unverified.
